title: A Spark, a Flint: How Fire Leapt to Life

sentences.en: The control of fire was the first and perhaps greatest of humanity’s steps towards a life-enhancing technology.
sentences.zh: 控制火灾是人类朝着增强生命技术迈出的第一步,或许是最大的一步。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: To early man, fire was a divine gift randomly delivered in the form of lightning, forest fire or burning lava.
sentences.zh: 火是给早期人类的神赐予的圣物以闪电、森林火或熔岩燃烧的形式随机送来

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Unable to make flame for themselves, the earliest people probably stored fire by keeping slow burning logs alight or by carrying charcoal in pots.
sentences.zh: 最早的人可能因为无法自己燃起火焰而把燃烧的木头保持缓慢的火光或把木炭装在锅里而储存着火。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: How and where man learnt how to produce flame at will is unknown.
sentences.zh: 人类如何学会随意制造火焰,而人们在哪里学会了如何制造火焰,这是未知的。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It was probably a secondary invention, accidentally made during tool-making operations with wood or stone.
sentences.zh: 可能是在木头或石头工具制造操作过程中无意产生的二级发明。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Studies of primitive societies suggest that the earliest method of making fire was through friction.
sentences.zh: 对原始社会的研究显示,最早的火力燃烧方法是通过摩擦。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: European peasants would insert a wooden drill in a round hole and rotate it briskly between their palms this process could be speeded up by wrapping a cord around the drill and pulling on each end.
sentences.zh: 欧洲农民会在一个圆洞里插入木钻, 并在他们手掌之间快速旋转, 可以通过在钻头上绑一条绳子, 并拉到每一端来加速这一过程。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The Ancient Greeks used lenses or concave mirrors to concentrate the sun’s rays and burning glasses were also used by Mexican Aztecs and the Chinese.
sentences.zh: 古希腊人用镜头或相像镜来集中太阳的光线, 墨西哥阿兹特克人和中国人也用燃烧的眼镜。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Percussion methods of fire-lighting date back to Paleolithic times, when some Stone Age tool-makers discovered that chipping flints produced sparks.
sentences.zh: 火灾的冲击方法追溯到石器时代当石器时代的一些工具制造者发现芯片火石产生火花

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The technique became more efficient after the discovery of iron, about 5000 vears ago In Arctic North America, the Eskimos produced a slow-burning spark by striking quartz against iron pyrites, a compound that contains sulphur.
sentences.zh: 在北冰洋北美,爱斯基摩人用石英对含硫的化合物铁火石进行撞击,从而产生一个燃烧缓慢的火花。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The Chinese lit their fires by striking porcelain with bamboo.
sentences.zh: 中国人用竹子敲打瓷瓷器点燃了他们的火。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In Europe, the combination of steel, flint and tinder remained the main method of fire-lighting until the mid 19th century.
sentences.zh: 在欧洲,钢铁、火石和铁板的结合在19世纪中叶之前一直是火烧的主要方法。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Fire-lighting was revolutionised by the discovery of phosphorus, isolated in 1669 by a German alchemist trying to transmute silver into gold.
sentences.zh: 1669年发现磷,一名德国炼金师试图将银化成金,1669年将磷孤立,使点火革命化。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Impressed by the element’s combustibility, several 17th century chemists used it to manufacture fire-lighting devices, but the results were dangerously inflammable.
sentences.zh: 17世纪的几位化学家在受到该元素可燃性的影响下,用它制造点火装置,但结果非常危险,易燃。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: With phosphorus costing the equivalent of several hundred pounds per ounce, the first matches were expensive.
sentences.zh: 磷的消耗相当于每盎司几百磅,第一批火柴价格昂贵。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The quest for a practical match really began after 1781 when a group of French chemists came up with the Phosphoric Candle or Ethereal Match, a sealed glass tube containing a twist of paper tipped with phosphorus.
sentences.zh: 1781年,法国化学家们提出磷光或地表火, 密封玻璃管, 上面装着磷粉的纸条。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: When the tube was broken, air rushed in, causing the phosphorus to selfcombust.
sentences.zh: 当管子破裂时,空气冲进,导致磷自燃。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: An even more hazardous device, popular in America, was the Instantaneous Light Box — a bottle filled with sulphuric acid into which splints treated with chemicals were dipped.
sentences.zh: 在美国流行的更危险的装置是即时光盒——装满硫酸的瓶子,用化学品处理的螺旋藻浸入其中。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The first matches resembling those used today were made in 1827 by John Walker, an English pharmacist who borrowed the formula from a military rocket-maker called Congreve.
sentences.zh: 1827年,约翰·沃克首次与今天的火柴相仿,他是英国药剂师约翰·沃克,他向一个叫Congreve的军事火箭制造者借了配方。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Costing a shilling a box, Congreves were splints coated with sulphur and tipped with potassium chlorate.
sentences.zh: 在一个盒子里花一先令康格里夫斯是被涂满硫磺并被氯化钾涂满的板块

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: To light them, the user drew them quickly through folded glass paper.
sentences.zh: 用户迅速通过折叠玻璃纸把它们拉出来,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Walker never patented his invention, and three years later it was copied by a Samuel Jones, who marketed his product as Lucifers.
sentences.zh: Walker从未申请过发明专利三年后被一个叫Samuel Jones的人复制了此人以路西法人的身份推销了他的产品

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: About the same time, a French chemistry student called Charles Sauria produced the first “strike-anywhere” match by substituting white phosphorus for the potassium chlorate in the Walker formula.
sentences.zh: 大约在同一时间,法国化学系学生查尔斯·索里亚(Charles Sauria) 制作了首个“打击任何地方”的比对,用白磷代替沃克公式中的氯化钾。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: However, since white phosphorus is a deadly poison, from 1845 match-makers exposed to its fumes succumbed to necrosis, a disease that eats away jaw-bones.
sentences.zh: 然而,由于白磷是一种致命毒药,从1845年接触其烟雾的匹配者死亡到腐朽,这种疾病吞噬了下巴骨头。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It wasn’t until 1906 that the substance was eventually banned.
sentences.zh: 直至1906年才最终禁用该物质。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: That was 62 years after a Swedish chemist called Pasch had discovered non-toxic red or amorphous phosphorus, a development exploited commercially by Pasch’s compatriot J E Lundstrom in 1885.
sentences.zh: 1885年,Pasch的同胞J E Lundstrom在商业上开发了无毒红磷或无态磷。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Lundstrom’s safety matches were safe because the red phosphorus was non-toxic; it was painted on to the striking surface instead of the match tip, which contained potassium chlorate with a relatively high ignition temperature of 182 degrees centigrade.
sentences.zh: 红磷是无毒的, 红磷被涂到触目地表, 而不是火线尖, 上面含有氯化钾, 点火温度相对较高, 高达182摄氏度。

sentences.en: It wasn’t until 1900 that the Diamond Match Company bought a French patent for safety matches — but the formula did not work properly in the different climatic conditions prevailing in America and it was another 11 years before scientists finally adapted the French patent for the US.
sentences.zh: 钻石配对公司购买了法国的安全匹配专利, 但配方在美国不同的气候条件下效果不佳, 科学家们终于将法国专利改换为美国,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The Americans, however, can claim several “firsts” in match technology and marketing.
sentences.zh: 然而,美国人在配对技术和营销方面可以声称“先行”几票。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In 1892 the Diamond Match Company pioneered book matches.
sentences.zh: 1892年,钻石匹配公司率先发起图书匹配。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The innovation didn’t catch on until after 1896, when a brewery had the novel idea of advertising its product in match books.
sentences.zh: 1896年之后, 一家酿酒厂才开始将产品在火柴书中做广告,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Today book matches are the most widely used type in the US, with 90 percent handed out free by hotels, restaurants and others.
sentences.zh: 今天的书赛是美国最常用的类型, 90%由旅馆、餐馆及其他人免费赠送。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Other American innovations include an anti-afterglow solution to prevent the match from smoldering after it has been blown out; and the waterproof match, which lights after eight hours in water.
sentences.zh: 美国的其他创新包括:采用抗后花法,防止火柴在熄灭后被烧;防水火柴在水中8小时后点燃。
